item.title: Weekly note: Stocks stay fully in, Bitcoin stays half in
item.description: No trades this week. The stocks desk stayed Risk On (fully invested, as it has been since April 9, 2025) and the Bitcoin desk stayed Balanced (half invested since October 16), so the flagship held at 85% invested. SPY closed Wednesday at $766.81, down 0.7% over the week but up 1.7% on Wednesday alone. Bitcoin ended at $80,419, down 1.0% over the week after a 4% bounce on Wednesday. The stocks desk's score slipped to +0.17 from +0.31 a month ago as chip stocks lagged the market, but strong trend readings keep it above the line where it would cut. Levels to watch: if SPY holds near $718 or below for about a week, the stocks desk would likely drop to Balanced. Bitcoin would likely go back to Risk On if it holds near $83,800 or above. Coming up: the October jobs report on Friday, November 6, and October CPI inflation on Tuesday, November 10. Both feed the stocks desk's macro inputs. The flagship's live record is eight sessions old (−0.01% against +0.65% for the S&P 500), far too short to judge.
